**Dog breeds that were in the AKC “top 10” every year from 2013 – 2024**

| Breed | 2013 rank | 2014 | 2015 | 2016 | 2017 | 2018 | 2019 | 2020 | 2021 | 2022 | 2023 | 2024 |
|-------|-----------|------|------|------|------|------|------|------|------|------|------|------|

| **German Shepherd Dog** | 2 | 2 | 2 | 2 | 2 | 2 | 2 | 3 | 4 | 4 | 4 | 4 |
| **Poodle** | 8 | 7 | 8 | 7 | 7 | 7 | 6 | 6 | **5** | **5** | **5** | **5** |
| **Beagle** | 4 | 5 | 5 | 5 | 6 | 6 | 7 | 7 | **7** | **8** | **8** | **7** |
| **Rottweiler** | 9 | 10 | 9 | 8 | 8 | 8 | 8 | 8 | 8 | **7** | 9 | 8 |
| **Bulldog** | 5 | 4 | 4 | 4 | 5 | 5 | 5 | 5 | 6 | 6 | 7 | 9 |

*All of the above breeds earned a rank of 10 or better in every single year from 2013 through 2024, so each one consistently appeared in the AKC's top‑10 popularity list.*

**Breeds that *did not* maintain a top‑10 spot every year**

- **French Bulldog** – ranked 11th in 2013 (only 10th or better from 2014 onward).  
- **German Short‑haired Pointer, Yorkshire Terrier** (and others) – fell out of the top 10 in at least one year.

Thus, the seven breeds listed above were the only ones that made the AKC top‑10 list each year for that 12‑year span.
